contract: PATCH /public/share/:slug/progress. PATCH cookie-bound shared progress returns 204, clamps time to duration and preserves it on subsequent public-share reads; absent/expired/wrong session denies.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: PATCH /public/share/:slug/progress requires the share_session_id cookie (404 without) and validates body currentTime before any lookup: null, absent, non-numeric or negative values answer 400 (so an unknown slug with an invalid body is 400, not 404). An unknown slug or a session not bound to that share answers 404. Success answers 204 with no body, stores Math.min(currentTime, session.duration) on the in-memory share session, keeps the same session id on later slug reads and persists no playbackSessions row. Deleted or expired shares answer 404.
